svg.aria-label: Durable execution, as in Temporal or Restate. A workflow runs steps such as charge card, reserve room and send email; the framework logs the result of each step. If the process crashes after step two, a new worker re-runs the workflow code from the start, but for steps already logged it returns the recorded result instead of calling the service again, so the card is not charged twice. The code must be deterministic for the replay to line up.
